title: [FMP-07a] 13구역 실제 기하 기반 NPC100 군중 fixture
scopeStatement: An NPC100 fixture standing on the real colliders and supports of the thirteen additively-loaded authored region scenes, captured with ConnectedWorldGeometry.Capture and driven at the real NPC body size (WorldBodyPresentation.NpcRadiusM = 0.41 m, NpcHeightM = 1.8 m). It is not the wall-only bottleneck fixture and not the 0.15 m laboratory calibration unit fixture. GeometricClassification is synthetic_design_not_facility_acceptance: the geometry is authored scene content, not a survey, and this is not a facility or railway acceptance test.
conclusion: All three required suites ran together in ONE Unity invocation with a single semicolon separator and all passed. NUnit root result is Passed, total 109, passed 109, failed 0, inconclusive 0, skipped 0. The per-suite totals sum exactly to the root total (22 + 70 + 17 = 109), which is the evidence the semicolon separator parsed and all three suites actually executed. The invocation ran on hash-pinned bytes whose pre-run and post-run hashes are equal. The declared authored geometry is not prose: DeclaredAuthoredGeometryMatchesTheCapturedAuthoredCollidersRegionByRegion compares all 148 declared AABBs in all 13 regions against the live capture within 0.001 m and passed, so the declaration and the authored scenes agree today.

criticRequirementsAndWhatClosedThem.requirement: 1. world-crowd-fixture.json must CONTAIN the thirteen regions' authored collider and nav geometry, not merely policies and counts.
criticRequirementsAndWhatClosedThem.stateBefore: The fixture carried GeometryLoad policies, a region roster and measurement items; the numbers a consumer needed to compare against the authored scenes were not in the file.
criticRequirementsAndWhatClosedThem.whatChanged: AuthoredGeometry and NavGeometry sections were added and are now required by Validate(). AuthoredGeometry declares 13 regions, each with its envelope rectangle, floor support surface id and rectangle, non-walkable beds, boundary wall thickness/height/segment count/solid length and every wall segment run, portal lintel boxes, ceiling collider presence, walkable support id list, passage supports (support rectangle, collider box, clear width/height, grade, guard prism counts, passage ceiling and door panel collider boxes) and derived furniture boxes. NavGeometry declares the exact runtime path-query configuration (agent radius margin, both query radii, height, climb, slope degrees and its source constant, voxel and tile overrides, min region area, walkable/barrier areas, query offset step, sample tolerance, require-path-complete, source hash and query keys).
criticRequirementsAndWhatClosedThem.evidence: DeclaredAuthoredGeometryMatchesTheCapturedAuthoredCollidersRegionByRegion compares every declared box against the live ConnectedWorldGeometry.Capture result within ToleranceM = 0.001 m: 148 declared boxes, 25 walkable supports, 76 wall segments, 12 passage supports over 13 regions. Passed.

criticRequirementsAndWhatClosedThem.requirement: 2. Apply the NPC100 body radius (0.41 m) and height, and separate the result completely from the existing abstract unit result with fixtureKind = actual.
criticRequirementsAndWhatClosedThem.stateBefore: The body size and the separation policy were declared, but the navigation query the run actually issued was not declared anywhere, so a record could keep the world-actual label while being measured at the abstract unit's radius.
criticRequirementsAndWhatClosedThem.whatChanged: The fixture declares FixtureKind = world_actual_collider_nav with Body.RadiusM = 0.41, Body.HeightM = 1.8, Body.AbstractUnitRadiusM = 0.15, and NavGeometry.WorldActualQueryKey = 0.41/1.8 against NavGeometry.AbstractUnitQueryKey = 0.15/1.8. Validate() refuses a record whose query keys are not the record's own declared body sizes, and refuses them being equal.

criticRequirementsAndWhatClosedThem.requirement: 3. Verify defences against the negative cases: missing region, wrong frame, and a radius shrink smaller than the real model that would conceal itself.
criticRequirementsAndWhatClosedThem.stateBefore: The missing-region and wrong-frame probes existed against the world profile, but nothing refused a declaration that dropped a region, moved one into the wrong frame, or reshaped an envelope to match a bad capture.
criticRequirementsAndWhatClosedThem.whatChanged: Validate() gained the AuthoredGeometry and NavGeometry clauses, and three test methods were added: 17 authored-geometry probes, 17 navigation probes plus the query-key shrink probe, and a structural-role vocabulary probe run in both directions against the live capture.
criticRequirementsAndWhatClosedThem.evidence: Every probe is asserted to fail for its OWN clause string, so the refusal cannot be produced by an unrelated failure: the missing-region probe must say 'Missing region geometry', the wrong-frame probe must say 'Wrong frame for <region> in AuthoredGeometry', and the shrink probe must say 'navigation query keys'. All passed.

authoredGeometryDeclaration.rule: 이 절은 13구역 저작 씬이 실제로 담는 구조 콜라이더와 보행 지지면의 기하다. 모든 값은 foundation/world/connected-world-profile.json 과 ConnectedWorldSceneBuilder 의 저작 산술의 순수 함수이며(중심·크기·배제·포털·천장·벽높이·포털 경사로만 계산), 저장소 밖에서 다시 계산할 수 있다. 따라서 이 절은 캡처가 아니라 선언이며, 실행 시점에 캡처된 실제 콜라이더·지지면과 대조하는 시험이 있다.
authoredGeometryDeclaration.coordinateSpace: 프로파일 좌표계다. 프레임 델타가 0인 캡처에서의 월드 AABB 와 같다. 시험은 캡처된 ColliderDescriptor 의 MinX/MaxX/MinZ/MaxZ/Bottom/Top, 그리고 ConnectedWorldGeometry.Support 의 MinX/MaxX/MinZ/MaxZ/기울기를 이 값과 ToleranceM 이내로 대조한다.

sourceBuilder.Role: Room/Corridor/Furnish/Equipment 가 위 값을 저작한다. 이 해시가 바뀌면 선언이 조용히 낡지 않도록 시험이 깨진다.

authoredGeometryDeclaration.notEnumeratedRule: 세 부류는 이 선언에 개수를 적지 않는다. (1) FBX 저작 메시에서 파생된 물리 콜라이더(Bench, InformationIsland, 장비 자산)는 저작 메시의 프리미티브 수에 달려 있다. (2) float32 누적 스텝으로 도는 절차 가구 상자(Provisional_SleeperAdapter 는 x += 1.2f, Provisional_ShopFront 는 x += 12f)는 반복 횟수가 스텝 누적에 달려 있다. (3) 정확히 셀 수 있는 절차 가구 상자(Provisional_RailAdapter, Provisional_BoardingScreen)는 DerivedFurnitureBoxes 에 AABB 를 그대로 적는다. 그 역할 이름만 AuthoredColliderRolesWithDerivedCount 와 MeshDerivedColliderRoles 에 남기고, 총계는 영수증 전용이다. 선언한 구조 콜라이더 수는 저작 메시 파생분을 포함한 캡처 총계보다 작아야 한다(작지 않으면 파생이 틀렸다).
authoredGeometryDeclaration.slopedSupportRule: 경사 통로(포털 FromPoint.Y != ToPoint.Y)의 지지면은 기울어진 상면 평면이다. Support 사각형은 상면 네 꼭짓점의 AABB 이고 CentreElevationM 은 그 사각형 중심에서의 평면 고도이며, Collider 상자는 여덟 꼭짓점 전체의 AABB 다. 두 값이 같다고 적으면 경사 통로에서 틀린다.
authoredGeometryDeclaration.meshDerivedRule: MeshDerivedColliderRoles 의 이름은 저작 오브젝트 이름(Bench, InformationIsland, 장비 자산)이다. 캡처에서 그 오브젝트의 콜라이더 이름은 FoundationAssetPhysics.Apply 가 foundation/art/asset-manifest.json 의 collisionBoxes[].part 로 붙이는 Collision_<part> 다. 따라서 이 지역에 캡처된 모든 콜라이더 역할은 (a) AuthoredColliderRolesWithDerivedCount 와 DerivedFurnitureBoxes 가 이름으로 선언한 역할이거나 (b) Collision_ 접두어를 가진 저작 메시 프록시여야 한다. 그 밖의 역할이 나타나면 선언이 낡은 것이므로 시험이 실패한다.
authoredGeometryDeclaration.derivedFurnitureNote: Two regions declare derived furniture boxes whose role the region also enumerates: rail_tracks_mainline -> Provisional_RailAdapter x2, metro_platforms -> Provisional_BoardingScreen x4. They are the only colliders in the fixture that carry a per-part box rather than a region rectangle, so they are named individually.

navGeometryDeclaration.Rule: 13구역 캡처 기하 위에서 군중 경로 질의가 실제로 쓰는 내비게이션 기하다. 값은 Packages/com.xrlab.chooguard.foundation/Multiplayer/Runtime/ConnectedWorldGeometry.cs 의 TryPath 와 그 캐시 키에서 그대로 읽은 선언이며, 시험은 이 파일의 해시를 고정해 코드가 바뀌면 선언이 조용히 낡지 않게 한다.
navGeometryDeclaration.SettingsSource: NavMesh.GetSettingsByIndex(0) 을 (radius,height) 키마다 복제해 쓴다. NavMeshAreas.asset 은 변경하지 않는다.
navGeometryDeclaration.QueryOffsetRule: (radius,height) 키마다 1000 m 씩 위로 분리해 반경별 navmesh 가 서로의 고도를 가리지 않게 한다.
navGeometryDeclaration.SourceSelectionRule: InitiallyEnabled 이고 PortalId 가 빈 콜라이더만 넣는다. BoxCollider 는 Box shape(트랜스폼 = AuthoredTransform * Translate(center), 크기 = box.size), MeshCollider 는 Mesh shape 로 넣고 area 는 Walkable ? 0 : 1 이다.
navGeometryDeclaration.BoundsRule: 선택된 모든 콜라이더의 모든 정점을 Encapsulate 한 뒤 Expand(2) 한다.
navGeometryDeclaration.NegativeRule: 에이전트 반경 여유(0.045 m)를 0 이하로 낮추거나, 슬로프를 GroundedWorldMotor.MaximumSlopeDegrees 가 아닌 값으로 바꾸거나, voxel/tile/minRegion 을 0 이하로 두거나, 에이전트 반경을 실제 동체 반경과 어긋나게 적으면 검증이 실패해야 한다. 줄어든 반경으로 좁은 통로를 통과시켜 실제 크기 군중을 가장하는 것이 이 절이 막는 음성 사례다.

fixtureSeparationFromTheAbstractUnitResu.note: The two records share the world and differ in the body. That is the point of the control: it isolates the effect of the real body size on the same authored geometry rather than comparing two different worlds.

Suites: Fmp07aWorldCrowdTests (22), WorldMotionAdapterTests (70), CrowdWorldContactTests (17). The Fmp07a suite covers the declared fixture contract, the supported-placement and no-overlap checks on the authored supports, the receipt-emitting NPC100 run, determinism on the same seed, neighbour-contact held bodies, the twelve-region/duplicate-view refusal, the disabled-collider and disabled-support refusals, the wrong-frame refusal, the kind-separation refusals in both directions, the measurement-item reflection check, and the four new authored-geometry and authored-role checks described under criticRequirementsAndWhatClosedThem.

negativeCaseGuards.status: covered and green in the recorded run
negativeCaseGuards.guard: Two layers. Capture side: ConnectedWorldGeometry.Capture throws ArgumentException('Server geometry requires each of the 13 region scenes exactly once.') for a partial or duplicate view set, asserted on three view sets (12 views, 11 views, 13+1). Declaration side: Validate() refuses an AuthoredGeometry that does not declare all 13 regions ('Missing region geometry: AuthoredGeometry must declare all 13 regions, found N'), refuses a duplicated RegionId, and refuses a declared region that the loaded world does not have ('Missing region <id> geometry'). The declared roster is compared against the authored world region by region in the same loop that checks scene names and frames.

negativeCaseGuards.status: covered and green in the recorded run
negativeCaseGuards.guard: Disabling one authored static collider makes ValidateSourceGeometry fail with 'Changed static collider availability <path>'; a body on a disabled authored support is refused at adapter construction with 'No authored support <id>'. Both restore and re-assert green afterwards, so the probe cannot be satisfied by a permanently broken world. The fixture requires the captured collider set to equal the loaded authored set exactly, with no silently skipped collider.

negativeCaseGuards.status: covered and green in the recorded run; the declaration-side probe is new
negativeCaseGuards.guard: Four-way. ConnectedRegionView.ApplyFrame throws 'Region frame mismatch.' for a frame other than the current one. The adapter refuses vertical frame moves, yaw changes and world-frame moves with 'Physical frames must preserve the fixed world and level straight-route orientation.', and a refused tick is not partially committed. The fixture requires each region's declared FrameId to equal the authored world's ('Wrong frame for <region> in AuthoredGeometry'), and the new probe re-labels a train-frame region as 'world' to prove that clause fires - it must be refused by the clause that says 'in AuthoredGeometry', not by an unrelated failure. The measured receipt independently confirms contactSpaceIds=['world'] for both records.

negativeCaseGuards.negativeCase: 실제 모델보다 작은 반경 / 반경 축소 은폐 (radius shrink smaller than the real model)
negativeCaseGuards.status: covered and green in the recorded run; the query-key layer is new
negativeCaseGuards.guard: Five layers, none of them a remembered threshold. (1) The authored Evacuee envelope is measured from the mesh vertices at run time; Validate() refuses Body.RadiusM < that measured envelope. (2) Validate() refuses Body.RadiusM != WorldBodyPresentation.NpcRadiusM, so the world-actual record cannot be shrunk at all. (3) The undersized probes in RadiusSmallerThanTheAuthoredModelAndMislabeledAbstractFixturesAreRefused are derived from the measured envelope (0.15 m, envelope/2, envelope-0.001), so the probe moves with the model. (4) NEW: NavGeometry must carry the query key the declared body size produces (WorldActualQueryKey = '0.41/1.8', AbstractUnitQueryKey = '0.15/1.8'), the two keys must differ, and the world query radius must exceed the abstract one - so a record that keeps the world-actual label while querying the abstract unit's navmesh is refused with 'The declared navigation query keys are not the declared body sizes.' (5) The receipt's own radiusM is a measured item, so a run that shrank the body would report the shrunk radius rather than the label.

sceneFileSha256IsNotReproducible.detail: The scene list the receipt hashes is a document digest, not a reproducible build: it depends on Unity's serializer output for the generated scenes, which this record does not attempt to pin to a generator revision.
sceneFileSha256IsNotReproducible.impact: A later reader can verify the scenes produced by the recorded run are internally consistent, but cannot independently regenerate byte-identical scene files from the fixture alone.
sceneFileSha256IsNotReproducible.remedy: The fixture declares the authored geometry the scenes must contain; the scene digest is evidence about one run, not part of the declaration.

commandedSpeedDeclaredInDoubleRatherThan.detail: The receipt's commanded speed is serialized from a double (0.20615528435283612) while the tick loop runs in float32, so the printed last digits exceed what the simulation carries.
commandedSpeedDeclaredInDoubleRatherThan.impact: Nothing observable: the bound is asserted at commanded + 1e-06, which is far above float32 noise at this magnitude.
commandedSpeedDeclaredInDoubleRatherThan.remedy: Out of scope for FMP-07a; the fixture's own declared quantities are all exact in float32 or cast explicitly, and the authored profile numbers are compared after the same rounding.

receiptCommandFieldIsATemplateNotTheInvo.detail: The receipt's `command` field shows the -testFilter shape with $EVIDENCE_DIR placeholders rather than this invocation's resolved output paths.
receiptCommandFieldIsATemplateNotTheInvo.impact: A consumer copying the field verbatim runs the suites but writes its results elsewhere.
receiptCommandFieldIsATemplateNotTheInvo.remedy: The resolved invocation is recorded in runs.invocationShape and as host.txt in the evidence directory; the reproduction script carries the literal filter.

receiptWrittenIntoUnityTemp.detail: The run writes its receipt under Temp/, which the editor removes on exit.
receiptWrittenIntoUnityTemp.impact: The receipt bytes are recoverable only from the FMP07A-RECEIPT log line, which is what the reproduction script does.
receiptWrittenIntoUnityTemp.remedy: reproduce-FMP-07a.sh extracts the line into fmp07a-world-crowd.json, and the receipt's own sha256 is recorded in receipt.sha256 above.

declaredBoxesCoverProceduralBoxesAndName.detail: The declaration enumerates every procedural box the builder creates, but the colliders derived from authored meshes are named Collision_<part> by FoundationAssetPhysics and are represented in the declaration only by their role list (MeshDerivedColliderRoles), not by per-box AABBs.
declaredBoxesCoverProceduralBoxesAndName.impact: A per-box comparison against a mesh-derived collider is not possible from the declaration; the declaration instead proves the vocabulary is complete (every captured role is declared or Collision_-prefixed) and the total count is checked.
declaredBoxesCoverProceduralBoxesAndName.remedy: Recorded as a declaration limit rather than hidden: the fixture's MeshDerivedRule states it, and the comparison test prints the per-region role inventory as FMP07A-GEOMETRY so a reader sees exactly which roles were compared as boxes and which as names.

residualGaps: The authored geometry in the fixture is derived from the builder in Packages/com.xrlab.chooguard.foundation/Multiplayer/Runtime/ConnectedWorldGeometry.cs at its pinned hash; if a later revision of that builder changes a region's boxes, the declaration must be regenerated and the comparison test will fail until it is - the failure is the point, but regeneration is a manual step.

The collider geometry in the rendered scenes is authored synthetic content, not the published floor plan. GeometricClassification = synthetic_design_not_facility_acceptance stands: this is not a facility or railway acceptance measurement.
